001package com.streamConverter.controller;
002
003/**
004 * Enumeration of supported output data types for stream controllers.
005 *
006 * <p>This enum defines the standard output types that can be produced by stream controllers,
007 * providing type safety and consistency across the controller factory and builder implementations.
008 *
009 * <p>Each output type represents a specific format or processing result that can be achieved
010 * through the controller framework. The enum values correspond to the capabilities of different
011 * controller implementations.
012 *
013 * <p>Usage examples:
014 *
015 * <pre>
016 * // Using enum instead of string literals
017 * IStreamController controller = ControllerFactory.getController("CSV", OutputType.CSV_COLUMN);
018 *
019 * // Type-safe controller creation
020 * IStreamController controller = ControllerFactory.createWithOutputType("JSON", OutputType.JSON_FORMATTED);
021 * </pre>
022 *
023 * @author StreamConverter Team
024 * @version 1.0
025 * @since 1.0
026 */
027public enum OutputType {
028
029  /** Extract specific CSV column data */
030  CSV_COLUMN("CSV_COLUMN", "Extract specific CSV column data"),
031
032  /** Process CSV data with additional transformations */
033  PROCESSED_DATA("PROCESSED_DATA", "Process data with additional transformations"),
034
035  /** Pass-through CSV processing */
036  CSV("CSV", "Pass-through CSV processing"),
037
038  /** Extract JSON property using JSONPath */
039  JSON_PROPERTY("JSON_PROPERTY", "Extract JSON property using JSONPath"),
040
041  /** Extract and validate JSON property */
042  VALIDATED_JSON_PROPERTY("VALIDATED_JSON_PROPERTY", "Extract and validate JSON property"),
043
044  /** Format JSON for readability */
045  JSON_FORMATTED("JSON_FORMATTED", "Format JSON for readability"),
046
047  /** Transform data with multi-stage processing */
048  TRANSFORMED_DATA("TRANSFORMED_DATA", "Transform data with multi-stage processing");
049
050  /** The string representation of the output type */
051  private final String value;
052
053  /** Human-readable description of the output type */
054  private final String description;
055
056  /**
057   * Constructs an OutputType with the specified value and description.
058   *
059   * @param value the string representation of the output type
060   * @param description the human-readable description
061   */
062  OutputType(String value, String description) {
063    this.value = value;
064    this.description = description;
065  }
066
067  /**
068   * Gets the string representation of this output type.
069   *
070   * @return the string value
071   */
072  public String getValue() {
073    return value;
074  }
075
076  /**
077   * Gets the human-readable description of this output type.
078   *
079   * @return the description
080   */
081  public String getDescription() {
082    return description;
083  }
084
085  /**
086   * Returns the string representation of this output type.
087   *
088   * @return the string value
089   */
090  @Override
091  public String toString() {
092    return value;
093  }
094
095  /**
096   * Converts a string value to the corresponding OutputType.
097   *
098   * @param value the string value to convert
099   * @return the corresponding OutputType, or null if not found
100   */
101  public static OutputType fromString(String value) {
102    if (value == null) {
103      return null;
104    }
105
106    for (OutputType type : values()) {
107      if (type.value.equals(value)) {
108        return type;
109      }
110    }
111
112    return null;
113  }
114
115  /**
116   * Checks if a string value represents a valid OutputType.
117   *
118   * @param value the string value to check
119   * @return true if the value is valid, false otherwise
120   */
121  public static boolean isValid(String value) {
122    return fromString(value) != null;
123  }
124}
